The '''Soz''' was an ancient [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] once used by the natives of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. Soz was also a commonly given name among [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], in reference to the revered weapon.
